title: Wang2016 – SSVEP Wang 2016 dataset
description: A benchmark steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) dataset comprising 64-channel EEG recordings from 34 healthy subjects performing a 40-target brain-computer interface speller task using joint frequency and phase modulation. The dataset includes 6 trials per target frequency (8–15.8 Hz) with 5-second visual stimulation epochs, providing a standardized resource for developing and evaluating SSVEP-based BCI algorithms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Synamps2 system (Neuroscan, Inc.) at 1000 Hz sampling rate with 64 channels positioned according to the international 10-20 system, referenced to vertex (Cz). Online filters included a bandpass filter (0.15–200 Hz) and 50 Hz notch filter. Continuous recordings were segmented into 6-second epochs (0.5 s pre-stimulus, 5 s stimulation, 0.5 s post-stimulus) and downsampled to 250 Hz. Subjects performed a cue-guided target selection task with 40 visual flicker stimuli presented on a 5×8 matrix at frequencies ranging from 8 to 15.8 Hz (0.2 Hz intervals).
